rules.source_excerpt_summary: Meta's mobile photo guidance recommends 1:1 or 4:5 instead of horizontal crops for feed use.
rules.interpretation: Define separate square and portrait media geometry families; this does not establish fixed pixel dimensions.

rules.source_excerpt_summary: Ads Manager treats uploaded image/video media and primary text, headline, description, CTA and destination as distinct ad inputs.
rules.interpretation: The renderer owns uploadable media pixels; platform copy, CTA and destination remain separate metadata.

rules.source_excerpt_summary: Meta describes a photo ad as imagery used with engaging copy and recommends high-resolution, focused, uncluttered images.
rules.interpretation: MVP output is the creative photo asset, not a reproduction of the surrounding Meta application UI.

rules.source_excerpt_summary: Meta recommends keeping image copy limited and the composition focused, but does not define a current hard percentage threshold on this page.
rules.interpretation: Do not restore the retired 20-percent rule; any text-density check is project guidance at INFO or WARNING severity only.

rules.source_excerpt_summary: Meta describes Stories as an immersive vertical full-screen surface for photos and videos across its Stories products.
rules.interpretation: Use a 9:16 vertical-full geometry family for Stories planning; no fixed pixel dimensions are inferred.

rules.source_excerpt_summary: Instagram advises leaving roughly 14 percent at the top and 20 percent at the bottom free of key elements so the default CTA sticker does not cover them.
rules.interpretation: Store normalized top/bottom exclusion guides and report intersections as WARNING; the word roughly forbids hard ERROR enforcement.

rules.source_excerpt_summary: Meta promotes 9:16 native Reels creative, states that key messages should remain in a safe zone, and confirms that image ads can participate in Reels.
rules.interpretation: A static 9:16 asset profile is a valid planned Reels input, while video/audio performance claims remain outside the static renderer contract.

rules.source_excerpt_summary: The official page requires key messages in a safe zone and points to dedicated checker assets, but the current public page text does not expose exact normalized geometry.
rules.interpretation: Do not import third-party pixel guides; exact Reels geometry remains SOURCE_REQUIRED until official checker bytes and provenance are captured.

rules.source_excerpt_summary: The carousel format supports up to ten image or video cards, each with its own link, and Meta may optimize card order unless the advertiser opts out.
rules.interpretation: Static card generation maps to ordered COLLECTION artifacts, but platform links, chrome and optional platform reordering are not rendered into pixels.

rules.source_excerpt_summary: Advantage+ creative can resize, expand, generate backgrounds, create text variations, overlay text, animate static images and otherwise adapt creative for placements.
rules.interpretation: The local renderer produces deterministic source assets only and must not claim to predict or reproduce Advantage+ output.

rules.source_excerpt_summary: Advantage+ placements automate delivery across Facebook, Reels, Instagram Stories, Instagram Feed, Messenger and Audience Network.
rules.interpretation: Placement compatibility is metadata separate from asset canvas identity and can evolve independently of renderer profiles.

rules.source_excerpt_summary: Meta describes Instagram photo ads as supporting square, landscape and portrait orientations without establishing a fixed landscape ratio on this page.
rules.interpretation: Landscape is real but deferred from the M1 mobile-first profile set until an ad-specific current ratio contract is captured.

rules.source_excerpt_summary: Meta Collection combines a primary media item, smaller product imagery and an Instant Experience or catalog-driven browsing flow.
rules.interpretation: Individual source creative generation may be local, but Collection presentation, catalog data and Instant Experience are platform-composed.

rules.source_excerpt_summary: Meta's Ads Guide is the placement-specific specification entry point referenced by its Photo, Stories, Reels, Carousel and Collection pages.
rules.interpretation: M1 must re-check this live entry point before freezing any fixed dimensions or file-size limits.
